symptoms: Pale green to yellowish diffuse spots on upper leaf surfaces
Dense olive-green to brown velvety fungal mold on leaf undersides
Leaves curl, wilt, and drop prematurely in high tunnel environments
risk_factors: High relative humidity (>85%) in greenhouses or poly-tunnels
prevention: Ventilate greenhouses and use circulation fans to keep humidity <85%
Select leaf-mold resistant tomato hybrids (Cf gene resistance)
recommended_actions: Increase exhaust ventilation immediately to lower ambient moisture
Apply potassium bicarbonate or bio-fungicide on leaf undersides
